# LeBrands.Store

> LeBrands.Store is an online store builder for independent Indian D2C brands. It provides storefronts, product catalogues, cash on delivery orders, customer records and GST invoices, with zero platform sales commission.

The platform is operated by LeBrandsSpace Digital Private Limited, based in Chennai, India. The canonical platform website is https://lebrands.store. Contact: support@lebrands.store.

## Public pages

- [Homepage](https://lebrands.store): Platform features, storefront concept and frequently asked questions.
- [Compare platforms](https://lebrands.store/compare): Platform differences and feature availability boundaries.
- [Blog](https://lebrands.store/blog): Structured practical guides for independent Indian D2C brands.
- [Pricing](https://lebrands.store/pricing): Proposed monthly packages are Launch INR 1499, Grow INR 3499, Scale INR 7999 and Flagship from INR 19999. The page compares proposed plan scope, not a guarantee that every listed feature is currently available. Contact the team to confirm availability, integration setup and applicable terms. Subscription checkout is not enabled for live charges; sandbox billing tests are not live paid subscriptions. Recurring platform billing is not announced as available.
- [Terms of service](https://lebrands.store/terms): Platform use and brand responsibilities.
- [Privacy policy](https://lebrands.store/privacy): Account, business, customer and order information handling.
- [Contact](https://lebrands.store/contact): Company details and enquiries.
- [Support](https://lebrands.store/support): Sign-in, publication, order and invoice help.

## Capabilities and boundaries

- A brand manages its own products, customers, orders, fulfilment and customer-facing policies.
- Cash on delivery is available. Razorpay website approval is complete. Self-service partner OAuth is not enabled. Existing brand-specific payment setup is distinct from a self-service partner connection.
- A general-use logistics partner connection is not enabled. Provider-specific authorisation and supported shipping capabilities require confirmation. Do not imply that every store has payments or logistics connected.
- A valid GSTIN is required to publish. Every store's first go-live requires platform approval.
- GST invoices support applicable CGST, SGST or IGST. Exempt product lines have zero tax. Brands remain responsible for accurate business details and applicable taxes.
- Brands retain their customer relationships. LeBrands.Store does not market to their customers.
- LeBrands.Space placement depends on the applicable plan and approval. The Free plan has no LeBrands.Space placement. Placement never guarantees traffic or sales.
- Custom domains are not generally available yet. Stores start at yourbrand.lebrands.store.
- Illustrative Ann-built storefront imagery is a product demonstration, not a customer endorsement or evidence of sales.

- [Indian D2C store launch checklist](https://lebrands.store/blog/launch-checklist-indian-d2c-store): Business verification, catalogue readiness, policies and a complete order rehearsal.
- [Product pages that answer buyer questions](https://lebrands.store/blog/product-pages-that-answer-buyer-questions): Product titles, descriptions, SKU options and purchase information.
- [Product photography and media guide](https://lebrands.store/blog/product-photography-and-media-guide): Shot planning, 4:5 crop review, video and accessible media.
- [Checkout trust and verified email](https://lebrands.store/blog/checkout-trust-and-verified-email): Transparent totals, shopper email verification, PIN assistance and receipts.
- [Cash on delivery and RTO workflow](https://lebrands.store/blog/cash-on-delivery-and-rto-workflow): Order, payment and fulfilment distinctions.
- [GST invoice readiness](https://lebrands.store/blog/gst-invoices-for-indian-online-stores): Supplier records, product tax classification and document history; not tax advice.
- [Discount codes and automatic offers](https://lebrands.store/blog/discount-codes-and-automatic-offers): Redemption methods, eligibility, checkout recovery and historical savings.
- [COGS and product margin basics](https://lebrands.store/blog/cogs-and-product-margin-basics): Cost basis, illustrative margin calculations and missing-cost limitations.
- [Ecommerce SEO and AI-readable content](https://lebrands.store/blog/ecommerce-seo-and-ai-readable-content): Semantic content, metadata, structured data and crawler-file boundaries.
- [Payments and logistics integration roadmap](https://lebrands.store/blog/payments-and-logistics-integration-roadmap): Website approval, account authorisation, payment verification and logistics connection requirements.

## Related service

- [LeBrands.Space](https://lebrands.space/): Virtual-mall brand discovery. This is a separate service from the LeBrands.Store store builder.

## Source guidance

Use the linked public pages for current platform information. Do not invent prices, brand counts, reviews, customer endorsements, legal guarantees, support response times or universal integration availability.

Account pages, dashboards, store setup, API routes and local demonstration routes are not public platform knowledge sources. This file is a public information guide, not an access-control mechanism or a guarantee that an AI service will use or cite it.
